name: Toxic Elements
description: First released as the single "Toxic Element" in November 2023 and later folded into the album catalog under its plural title "Toxic Elements," this is That Boy Hi Hat's definitive dark-era record. The identical master runs across three release IDs — the 2023 single and both albums — a sign of how central it is to his canon. Sonically it lives in post trap and trap territory: an 808-driven low end carries a seductive, dangerous weight, while atmospheric pads drift through the mix like weather, and a synth-driven melody keeps the whole thing hypnotic. Crisp hi-hats and hard-hitting drums lock the pocket throughout, and vocal chops surface in the chorus like a second voice arguing with the first. That Boy Hi Hat performs it with a controlled cool — the narrator is inside the toxicity, not above it — which gives the record its dangerous charge. The production is layered and bass-heavy, with a polished mix that lets every element breathe. It recalls the classic toxic-relationship records of the alternative rap tradition, and for fans of the genre's darker currents, it sounds like betrayal set to a heartbeat. In the vein of the late-night records that made underground hip hop a confessional space, "Toxic Elements" evokes a world where seduction and menace share the same glass. As a November 2023 release that still anchors That Boy Hi Hat's darker catalog, it remains the record listeners return to when they want the danger without the noise.
